narrative.northStar: Forest and mint Subloom, made personal
narrative.overview:
Subloom retains its forest/mint default, DM Sans/Manrope, Lucide icons and rounded semantic primitives. The authorized expansion makes the consumer interface more playful through eight predefined accents, financial object illustrations, inviting action cards and explicit success/failure feedback. Readability and clear financial tasks still lead the design.

Shared React Native primitives serve Expo native and web surfaces. Tonal fills, contrasting spotlight cards, thin borders and visible focus establish hierarchy. Original tactile 3D wallet, cards, coins and renewal-calendar artwork add depth around financial tasks in the earlier UI handoff. These objects express the financial subject; they do not introduce a brand mascot.

Fourfold Bloom is the fixed brand identity: four matching rounded petals from the original native mark, with one outlined wordmark with an uppercase S and no trailing period. `brand/source/identity.json` owns the geometry and fixed palette; `brand/GUIDE.md` governs applications. The app and website consume generated data from that same master. This brand commitment leaves the existing accent preferences and financial behavior intact.
keyCharacteristics: Fixed Fourfold Bloom geometry and outlined wordmark across app and website.
Forest and mint remain the default; eight accent choices work independently of appearance.
Manrope headings above DM Sans body text, labels and tabular numbers.
Rounded tonal controls, thin semantic borders, named Lucide actions and visible focus.
Tactile financial artwork and contrasting action cards without changing financial meaning.
Bounded feedback motion with shared system reduced-motion checks.

rules.name: The Theme Pair Rule
rules.body: Resolve semantic colors through `useTheme()`; keep foregrounds, grounds and borders in the same resolved theme. Accent and saved light/dark/system appearance are independent preferences. System appearance follows the device scheme.

rules.name: The Fixed Logo Color Rule
rules.body: Personal accents never recolor the logo. Use brand Green for the mark and Forest for the outlined wordmark on light surfaces; use Bloom Mint for both on dark surfaces. Resolve interface controls through the existing theme independently.

rules.name: The Outlined Wordmark Rule
rules.body: Render the supplied outlined Manrope 700 wordmark, `Subloom` with an uppercase S, without a trailing period. Keep Manrope and DM Sans interface text independent of the fixed logo geometry.

rules.name: The Numeric Reading Rule
rules.body: Preserve the shared tabular-number treatment and keep financial labels readable while motion runs; do not move exact money calculations into animation worklets.

rules.name: The Restrained Surface Rule
rules.body: Extend the incumbent bordered, tonal surfaces; use the committed financial artwork for tactile depth.

rules.name: The One Master Rule
rules.body: The Fourfold Bloom mark and outlined wordmark with an uppercase S form one fixed identity across app and website. Read `brand/GUIDE.md` before any brand change; edit `brand/source/identity.json` deliberately and regenerate, never redraw or retype a local logo.

rules.name: The Feedback Without Travel Rule
rules.body: Preserve state and readable labels when system reduced motion suppresses spatial or entrance animation. Source support is established; native runtime, OS reduced-motion settings and browser reduced-motion emulation were not exercised in the playful UI handoff.

dos: **Do** reuse the generated Fourfold Bloom mark and outlined wordmark; regenerate and run the brand drift check after a deliberate master change.
**Do** use the resolved semantic theme pairs, installed fonts, Lucide icons and shared primitives.
**Do** keep accent and appearance independent, and keep feedback colors stable when accents change.
**Do** reuse the committed financial object artwork with descriptive text and named actions.
**Do** preserve visible focus, named actions, selected/busy/disabled semantics and usable compact touch controls.
**Do** retain bounded feedback and system reduced-motion paths.
**Do** keep original currencies and date-only financial semantics legible; distinguish recurring estimates from imported payment facts.
**Do** preserve guest persistence, owner-isolated saves, draft protection and contextual error recovery.
donts: **Don't** recolor the logo with a personal accent, retype the wordmark, add a trailing period, redraw the petals or introduce a sprout, paired leaf or eight-petal alternate.
**Don't** stretch, crop, rotate, shadow or independently animate the petals; preserve the master geometry and clear space.
**Don't** remove the Green default or replace the shared typography and rounded primitive language when extending this system.
**Don't** substitute a brand mascot for the financial objects requested for this interface.
**Don't** hide required compact actions behind hover or swiping.
**Don't** communicate financial or error meaning through color alone.
**Don't** imply planning records, simulations, reminders or manually recorded cancellation perform merchant billing or money movement.
**Don't** treat source-level accessibility or native bundle exports as proof of untested device behavior.
